body:
Merry Mirth
CR 8

A mirthling jester is a captivating figure of boundless energy and infectious laughter.

XP 4,800
Mirthling jester 9
CN Medium humanoid (mirthling)
Init +4; Senses Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+5 armor, +4 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 63 (9d8+18)
Fort +5, Ref +10, Will +8

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee marotte +8 (1d6+1)
Ranged deck of cards +9 (1d4+1)
Jester Spells Known (CL 9th; concentration +13)

4th (2/day)—cascade of orbs, jest of the forgotten archive
3rd (4/day)—jest of memory’s rain, jest of the hidden path, jest of the shifting dune
2nd (5/day)—jest of the abandoned guard tower, jest of the burning wind, jest of the crossroad’s tavern
1st (6/day)—jest of the frozen slope, jest of the shadowscape, jest of the enveloping mire

Pranks (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, light, mage hand, prestidigitation, summon instrument

TACTICS

Before Combat: The jester uses his Jest of the Desert Henge to confuse his enemies.

During Combat: The jester prefers to stay at range, using his spells and deck of cards to deal damage while supporting his allies with his jests.

Morale: If reduced to less than 15 hit points, the jester attempts to escape, using his spells and skills to evade his enemies.

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 18
Base Atk +6/+1; CMB +7, CMD 21
Feats Dodge, Mobility, Weapon Finesse, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot
Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +16, Diplomacy +16, Knowledge (Arcana) +13, Perception +12, Perform (comedy) +16, Perform (juggling) +16, Stealth +16, Use Magic Device +16
Languages Common, Elven, Gnome
SQ henge power (Desert Henge: Fool’s Fumble, Jest of the Desert Henge, Mirage)

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Gear short sword, light crossbow, chain shirt, bardic performance tools, spell component pouch, other standard adventuring gear

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Laughter Nourishment (Ex)

The jester does not consume food in the conventional sense. Instead, he is nourished by an observer’s laughter or awe. This unique trait allows him to survive without food as long as he performs successfully for an audience at least once a day.

ABOUT

In combat, he transforms ordinary objects like a marotte and a deck of cards into unexpected weapons, displaying a surprising level of skill. Beneath his chaotic exterior lies a deep sense of virtue. His performances, while entertaining, are also a means to spread joy and subtly challenge societal norms. More than a jester, Merry Mirth is a storyteller, philosopher, and rebel, using laughter as a tool to reflect the world’s absurdities.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
